shared_elements: row of crouching quadrupeds in profile along the upper edge
horizontal band of repeated angular/zigzag or triangular motifs
register of animals in procession beneath the band
large bird-like/long-necked creature in low relief on the shaft
low-relief carving with flat raised surfaces and outlined bodies
justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme: a row of crouching quadrupeds in profile along the top edge of a broad slab, directly above a horizontal band of repeated angular/net-like motifs, with a further register of profile animals below and a large long-necked bird-like creature on the shaft beneath. Differences are only in the number and identity of individual animals in the lower registers and the visible framing/angle, not in the compositional scheme or carving conventions.
